title: 1997 Collector's Choice All-Star Connection #23 Tony Gwynn Padres HOF Insert
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
1997 Upper Deck Collector's Choice All-Star Connection insert #23 of 45, Tony Gwynn, San Diego Padres - Hall of Famer. Foil front; back recalls him scoring the winning run in the 10th inning of the 1994 All-Star Game.

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
